她流产后，家人给予了安慰和支持。
People who miscarry should have access to compassionate medical care and appropriate psychological support.
流产者应能获得充满关怀的医疗服务和适当的心理支持。
miscarry early in pregnancy｜孕早期流产
通常指流产；表示计划失败时较正式且少见。
A person or organisation that accepts insurance risks.
An institution guaranteeing to buy securities not purchased by investors.
The underwriter checked our roof before approving the insurance.
承保人在批准保险之前检查了我们的屋顶。
An underwriter assesses potential losses before deciding whether to offer insurance for buildings in areas prone to flooding.
承保人会评估潜在损失，再决定是否为易受洪灾地区的建筑提供保险。
保险领域指承保人，证券领域指承销商。
Transfer goods from one ship or vehicle to another.
Workers transshipped the crates onto a smaller boat.
工人们把这些板条箱转运到一艘较小的船上。
Shipping companies often transship cargo at major ports to reduce costs and reach smaller markets.
航运公司常在主要港口转运货物，以降低成本并进入较小的市场。
过去式为transshipped，现在分词双写p。
a tree mainly native to Australia, with strongly scented leaves
A koala rested high in the eucalyptus tree.
一只考拉在高高的桉树上休息。
Planting eucalyptus outside its native range may affect local water supplies and reduce biodiversity.
在原生分布区以外种植桉树可能影响当地供水，并减少生物多样性。
指树种；eucalyptus oil指从桉树叶提取的精油。
